cover.title: REAL SOUNDS NASA RECORDED IN SPACE

comment: Comment WE HEAR YOU for Voyager 1

lines.text: They told you space is silent. NASA spacecraft have been listening to it for decades.
Put your headphones on. Every sound you're about to hear is real.
There's no air out there, so no sound the way you know it. But space is full of charged particles... and they make waves.
Spacecraft catch those waves with antennas. Play them through a speaker... and this is Earth.

listen.label: EARTH  ·  "CHORUS"
listen.credit: Audio: NASA & Univ. of Iowa / space-audio.org / CC BY 4.0

lines.text: Scientists call it chorus, because it sounds like birds at dawn. It's electrons, trapped in the radiation belts around our planet.
This one starts as lightning on Earth. The crack races along the planet's magnetic field... and comes back as a falling whistle.

listen.label: EARTH  ·  "WHISTLERS"
listen.sub: LIGHTNING IN SPACE  ·  REAL SPACECRAFT RECORDING
listen.credit: Audio: NASA & Univ. of Iowa / space-audio.org / CC BY 4.0

lines.text: Now leave Earth. March 5th, 1979. Voyager 1 is flying past Jupiter... and it hears this.

listen.label: JUPITER  ·  VOYAGER 1  ·  1979
listen.credit: Audio: NASA & Univ. of Iowa / space-audio.org / CC BY 4.0

lines.text: Saturn screams too. Cassini picked up these radio waves... coming from the auroras at its poles.

listen.label: SATURN  ·  CASSINI
listen.credit: Audio: NASA & Univ. of Iowa / space-audio.org / CC BY 4.0

lines.text: And this... is a thunderstorm on Saturn. January 2006. Turned into sound from Cassini's radio data.

listen.label: LIGHTNING ON SATURN  ·  2006
listen.sub: REAL CASSINI DATA  ·  CONVERTED TO SOUND
listen.credit: Audio: NASA & Univ. of Iowa / space-audio.org / CC BY 4.0

lines.text: This month, the Empire State Building turned gold... for Voyager 1.
The same probe that heard Jupiter is passing one full light-day from Earth. No human-made object has ever been that far.
It launched in 1977. Now a message sent to it takes an entire day to arrive.
And it's carrying a golden record of Earth's sounds... out into the dark.
Space was never silent. We just weren't listening. Comment, we hear you... for Voyager.
